dependencies.required_evidence: Terminal positive q1 A/B qualification and exact complete-package accounting.
Independent source audit of bounded post-WRT template name, explicit field key, positional field index, field boundaries, nesting, overflow, and mismatch behavior.
A frozen direct Fiber-CTS probability stream must pass the atlas gate before native q1 integration.

contract.role: first semantic virtual-time predictor and required predecessor to WIKI-LOOM
contract.scientific_question: Does route-local byte history become predictively adjacent when the decoder advances a bounded model only on values of the same already-decoded template field?
not_checkpointing: The authoritative parent is never copied, restored, forked, rejoined, or overwritten.
The source stream remains in physical order and no route, position, distance, length, or selector is transmitted.
Only a bounded auxiliary context model advances in semantic virtual time.

causal_route.eligibility: a value byte is eligible only after the complete bounded template and field descriptor is decoded
causal_route.limits: template and key at most 96 bytes each, nesting depth at most 16
causal_route.overflow: sleep without route update until the parser returns to a valid bounded state
causal_route.field_entry_miss: a route-bank fingerprint miss sleeps for the complete current field, then installs after the entry decision; prediction begins only on a later exact hit
causal_route.order: resolve route and virtual suffix from prior truths, emit eight bit probabilities, consume the physical byte, then update exactly that route's virtual suffix and CTS nodes

route_bank.index: low 12 bits of the frozen unsigned-64 descriptor hash
route_bank.record: 128-bit nonzero descriptor fingerprint, last eight virtual bytes, saturated 32-bit virtual support, and 32-bit validity/generation
route_bank.collision: fingerprint mismatch sleeps and no state is blended; the diagnostic manifest retains canonical descriptor bytes and treats any observed equal-fingerprint unequal-descriptor alias as fatal scientific evidence

context_table.key: 128-bit route fingerprint, packed 64-bit virtual suffix, and 16-bit node code containing context depth, current-byte bit index, and decoded bit prefix
context_table.value: two saturated uint16 zero/one counts, two signed Q31 context/switch weights, and 16-bit validity/generation; the complete packed record is statically asserted to 40 bytes
context_table.index: frozen unsigned hash masked to 18 bits
context_table.collision: stored-key mismatch makes that node absent before truth; replacement and update occur only after truth

bounded_state.rule: Source layout must prove the exact 32-byte records and total allocation before execution; design arithmetic is not a memory receipt.

prediction.contexts: orders zero through eight over preceding bytes in that route's virtual timeline plus the already decoded prefix of the current physical byte
prediction.estimator: binary KT leaves combined by deterministic integer Context Tree Switching; no trained parameter blob
prediction.awake: an exact route hit with at least 16 prior virtual bytes and at least one exact context node
prediction.sleep: send the authoritative parent count exactly and do not update a specialist posterior
prediction.numeric_contract: all leaf probabilities, switch weights, normalization, rounding, saturation, and update ordering must be frozen in source and differential-verified before an atlas trace
prediction.parent_boundary: P and K preserve every parent probability, state transition, learning update, coder transition, payload byte, and inverse byte

arms.K: identical parser, route bank, context lookup/update, hashes, and sleeping schedule but always send P to the coder and forbid specialist-to-parent writes
arms.G: one physical eligible-byte timeline using identical CTS geometry and update count
arms.S: immediately preceding completed field descriptor with identical geometry and eligibility
arms.R: deterministic random route assignment with identical table geometry and update cadence
arms.N: aligned route with complemented candidate bit probability
arms.M: only after D is independently positive, one separately versioned SAFE-MIX v2 finite-coder wrapper against P

gates.atlas: On frozen 1M and 10M populations, D must beat P, G, S, R, and N in ideal truth-path bits, remain positive in every chronological third, and reach at least 40,793 byte-equivalent at 10M to authorize native integration.
gates.native: Exact opening-10M P/K/D finite archives and inverses; P equals K in probabilities, parent state, coder state, payload, and inverse; D repeats byte-identically and saves at least 40,793 payload bytes before package cost.
gates.transfer: One unchanged distant-10M replay must remain positive before cumulative 100M.
gates.retirement: If the frozen direct model is subscale, noncausal, nonrepeatable, nonpositive in a third, or fails to beat G/S/R/N, retire this semantic virtual-time context claim before WIKI-LOOM; do not sweep routes, orders, slots, table size, or support.

contract.loom_route: WIKI-LOOM is authorized only if Fiber-CTS proves semantic virtual time but a preregistered residual atlas shows target-bearing route-local value not captured by the CTS endpoint.

activation_requirements: q1 is terminally qualified and no exclusive full-1G lease or acquisition lock exists.
The parser, descriptor encoding, hashes, exact-key witnesses, record layouts, CTS integer law, controls, populations, schemas, and output closure are content-addressed.
The direct D probability stream passes the frozen Causal Surprisal Atlas gate without post-hoc route or context selection.
Gamma Mechanism IR compiles source-bound P/K/D/G/S/R/N closures and proves no specialist-to-parent write.
A source-level allocation proof fits the incremental-memory ceiling before build or run.
claim_boundary: WIKI-FIBER-CTS is a zero-credit design; no source, probability trace, archive, inverse, or measured saving exists.
The declared table sizes are prospective resource bounds, not observed memory compliance.
Context-tree theory does not prove route quality, hash behavior, archive gain, package value, or the Hutter target.
The 40,793-byte gates are preregistered target-bearing thresholds, not forecasts.
